#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;
long long stirling[5001][5001];

long long modInverse(long long x, long long p) {
    long long res = 1;
    long long base = x % p;
    long long exp = p - 2;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % p;
        base = (base * base) % p;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    stirling[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 5001; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j < 5001; j++) {
            stirling[i][j] = (stirling[i - 1][j - 1] + j * stirling[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }

    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    istringstream iss(line);
    long long n, m;
    int k;
    iss >> n >> m >> k;

    long long invM = modInverse(m, MOD);
    long long currentProduct = 1;
    long long result = 0;
    long long currentProb = 1;

    for (int i = k; i > 0; i--) {
        currentProduct = (currentProduct * (n - (k - i))) % MOD;
        currentProb = (currentProb * invM) % MOD;
        result += ((currentProduct * currentProb) % MOD) * stirling[k][k - i + 1];
        result %= MOD;
    }

    cout << result << "\n";

    return 0;
}
